summary: Implemented the speed indicator in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a classmethod render_speed, and a render branch for unknown totals; track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total None for unsized iterables instead of raising. Added a CHANGELOG line under Unreleased/Added, added test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions, so validation is by reading only. Nothing was committed.
